summary: First 0.51 release through the standard release process: the September production build plus the two fixes of 0.50.1. Nothing to do before upgrading with the default nginx ingress.

changes.description: Uploads of files with non-ASCII characters in their name are no longer truncated.
When this device is removed from the account, the login page says so again instead of sometimes showing no reason.
Shared Drive uploads by drag and drop, of files and folders, with status, retry and cancel; viewer and editor roles.
Instant meetings with Meet now, time zone aware recurrence, meeting names kept in sync.
MLS reset system messages, unread messages kept across the migration, read receipts disabled for MLS and mixed conversations.
Client API versions 1 to 17 are supported; meetings need version 17 on the backend.
ingress.enabled is replaced by routing.enabled and routing.mode; the old value still works in this release.

configuration.description: Renders the HTTP Service and the Ingress or Gateway API resources. Replaces ingress.enabled, which stays as a deprecated alias in this release.
Controller for web traffic: nginx renders an Ingress, envoy renders a Gateway API HTTPRoute, migration renders both with weighted external-dns records.
Name of the existing Gateway used when routing.mode is envoy or migration; mandatory in those modes.
Deprecated alias of routing.enabled, kept for one release. Move to routing.enabled.
